Trump Administration Unveils New Tariffs for China, the European Union, and More

The Trump Administration on Wednesday proposed sweeping new tariffs on 14 major trading partners, including China and the European Union , threatening to reignite global trade tensions. China is set to be hit with the highest rate, facing tariffs of up to 20% on most covered goods.
